# Columns: <set key> TAB <integer seconds>. The key is the set itself, or for
# a distro set (a comma list carrying a sbo_distro_* stamp) that stamp, so a
# catalog change to the distro's tag list keeps its row. A set with no row
# weighs 120 s (about the median single set). Lines starting with '#' and
# A HEURISTIC ONLY: the batches are a partition of the set list whatever the
# numbers say (each set goes to exactly one batch), so a stale row costs
# Source (lane CICD, 2026-11-01, "Vet only"): from the omit-tag batch logs of
# (7d8f2d643), the max of the two. An edition row is its whole log group
# (vet and full tests). A single sbo_omit_* row is its vet time only, which
# is all it runs now: the time from its group's start to its first test
# output line, an upper bound (it includes the first tagged package's test
# build). Singles total about 211 minutes of vet, editions 46 minutes of
# vet and tests; LPT plans six batches of about 43 minutes each.
